Digital privacy during separation A shared cloud account or an old tablet can stay connected after you separate. Dr. Lior Tabansky works with you in person to see what still connects you and what you want to change. Start with a free private conversation Message on WhatsApp · Message on Signal Opens messaging. It does not book an appointment or start a call. Before you get in touch In person · With you present · You control your credentials What still connects you? A connection can be easy to forget and still be useful. Toza looks at what each arrangement allows, so you can decide what to keep and what to change. A family cloud account that still shares photos or documents.A recovery number or email that still belongs to your spouse.An old phone or tablet still signed in to your messages.A location-sharing setting you turned on years ago. Change things in the right order. An old tablet can still be signed in even after you change the password. Leaving a family plan can also affect a service you rely on. Dr. Tabansky checks your own devices, accounts and recovery settings with you. You stay present, enter your own credentials and choose which changes to approve. You agree the sequence together before anything changes. Your attorney can be involved. With your authorization, you receive an attorney-friendly summary of the work and what remains, and timing can be coordinated with counsel. About Dr. Lior Tabansky What happens first? The free private conversation usually takes 10–20 minutes. Dr. Tabansky replies personally. You discuss what prompted you to get in touch, whether anything needs prompt attention and whether an in-person assessment would help. How Toza works Private Exposure Assessment The assessment costs ₪4,000 and takes about half a day in person. You keep a written exposure summary showing what was checked, what remains and which steps come next. If you choose protection work, you agree on its scope and price separately. The assessment fee is credited in full when protection work begins within 30 days of assessment completion.
